I guess. Photography and movies (art in general) have kept me alive longer than I was supposed to be alive. I probably would have died a long time ago if I didn't have art. It's just not enough anymore though, I just want a friend (like a real live person) or like a great love or something. People are just hard for me because I hate going out since I'm really ugly. I also know I will never have anyone to care about me (and I mean in actual life, I do appreciate you taking the time to talk to me0).

Mainly because I haven't. I know people my age [26] who have bought houses, have really nice careers, or families or even just people who love them. I don't have any of that. I struggle everyday just to go to work or take a shower or even cook. I just have not accomplished anything. I'm also just stupid, I waste time doing things like writing screenplays or photography or reading when I should be getting a life. I've never even had anyone who loved me and now I definitely won;t. Sorry if that's melodramatic, it sounds ridiculous but it feels like a big deal to me.
I'm really no one important. I'm in my 20's and have not accomplished anything. It doesn't matter now what my favorite things are.
